company.metaTitle: Company — about us and certifications | ISOTEK LATAM
company.metaDescription: ISOTEK LATAM: industrial engineering company founded in 2015 in Bolivia. 200+ projects, 100+ people, ISO 9001:2015 and IEC 61439.
company.title: Bolivian engineering with regional reach.
story: ISOTEK LATAM (ISOTEK Innovative Solutions SRL) is an industrial engineering and solutions company headquartered in Bolivia, founded in 2015. We have delivered more than 200 projects in Bolivia, Paraguay, Argentina, Peru and the United States.

We are the exclusive representative of Endress+Hauser, a Siemens partner, and hold certified experience integrating ABB and Schneider Electric equipment. Backed by a holding company with a presence in LATAM, the USA and Asia, we specialise in engineering and delivering industrial projects.
Our technical advice focuses on process optimisation: shorter installation times, greater energy savings and, as a result, higher profitability for production units.
people: sales engineers in Bolivia, Peru, Paraguay and Argentina
company.mission: To become a strategic partner for our clients, delivering optimal mechatronic and electrical solutions that translate into real gains in quality, reliability and productivity.
company.vision: To build solid industry leadership and be recognised as the benchmark for industrial solutions in Bolivia, committed to excellence and constant innovation.
